whoItsFor: Developers and lifting enthusiasts who want a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker on their own server, with their data kept in a folder they control and no subscription or telemetry.
useCases: Plan weekly routines and run guided workouts with logged sets, rest timers, and PR detection
Track body weight and progress photos, and review muscle volume, recovery, and 1RM trends
Import training history from FitNotes, Strong, or Hevy and sync between phone and laptop behind passkey login
